development_relations.claim: A1.D1 may precede and contribute to later A1.D2 development.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: prerequisite requires evidence beyond prediction; causal_instructional requires intervention.

development_relations.claim: A1.D2 may precede and contribute to later A1.D3 development.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: prerequisite requires evidence beyond prediction; causal_instructional requires intervention.

development_relations.claim: A1.D1 may predict later A1.D3 directly or through intermediate development.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: do not infer direct prerequisite if an intermediate or parallel route explains the data.

development_relations.claim: B1.D1 may precede and contribute to later B1.D2 development.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: prerequisite requires evidence of restricted access to B1.D2 without B1.D1.

development_relations.claim: B1.D2 may precede and contribute to later B1.D3 development.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: prerequisite requires ruling out independent strategy development routes.

development_relations.claim: B1.D3 may precede and contribute to later B1.D4 development.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: prerequisite requires evidence that integrated performance cannot emerge through an alternative route.

development_relations.claim: B1.D1 may predict later B1.D4 development, potentially through intermediate developments.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: do not treat distal prediction as proof of a direct prerequisite.

development_relations.claim: FR2.D1 may precede and contribute to later FR2.D2 development.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: prerequisite requires evidence beyond successful recognition performance.

development_relations.claim: FR2.D2 may precede and contribute to later FR2.D3 development.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: prerequisite requires ruling out functional use through alternative non-explanatory routes.

development_relations.claim: FR2.D1 may predict later FR2.D3 development directly or through FR2.D2.
development_relations.stronger_claim_requires: do not infer a direct prerequisite when an intermediate route explains the relation.

required_negative_tests: task difficulty/familiarity alternatives must be considered where relevant
representation/context/language alternatives must be considered where relevant
reciprocal relations must be considered where theory and data permit
shared latent explanations must be considered for correlated developments
candidate_order must not be treated as confirmed ordering
